title: TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours Remote Sessions on Weekends and After Hours
content:
**Remote band schedule.** The block hours of a TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours remote session resolved on a Saturday or Sunday are multiplied by the block's holiday multiplier; those of a weekday remote session resolved in the after-hours class, by the block's after-hours multiplier; those of a weekday business-hours remote session, by 1. The day and class are those of the ticket's resolution; a weekday observed holiday takes the multiplier of the resolution's class.

| Resolution | Multiplier |
|---|---|
| Saturday or Sunday | holiday multiplier of the size |
| Monday to Friday, after-hours class | after-hours multiplier of the size |
| Monday to Friday, business-hours class | 1 |

Hypothetical case on a TimeBank 320-Hour Block (holiday multiplier 1.5, after-hours multiplier 1.25) for a session converting to 1.00 hour before this multiplier: 1.50 hours on a Saturday, 1.25 hours on a weekday evening in the after-hours class, 1.00 hour in weekday business hours.
